title: Concept: Unescaped HTML sink $(el).html(payload) (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, $(el).html(payload) inserts raw markup into a page. Unescaped sinks turn stored or reflected input into script execution in the victim's session. The javascript-specific remedy is contextual escaping via text() binding or a sanitizer.
applicability: javascript codebases rendering values through $(el).html(payload); single-line lexical scope.
risk: Stored or reflected cross-site scripting when untrusted input reaches the sink; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for stored sinks on authenticated pages.
